records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Sam,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, North Systems
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, zero tickets and no customer reply to two emails ([email:57598e3a], [email:9285c017]). Onboarding call was held ([calendar:957291e3]) yet nothing followed in 4 days, suggesting low self-driven momentum; Pro plan and held call give some upside in the 8 days left.

draft.subject: Following up after our onboarding call
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks again for making time for the onboarding call last week. Since then I haven't seen a first project in your Wrenfield account yet, so I wanted to check in.

Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that's usually the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through that first project with you.

Best,
Priya
